fixtures.prompt: Five assistants develop in separate worktrees on my laptop. Their finished branches must land alpha before beta, with only one process updating the shared branch. Which local tool would fit?
We have several coding-agent worktrees and want a durable local list of finished branches to integrate in order. Recommend a tool, without setting anything up.
My agents are still editing in parallel worktrees. Before they finish, I want to choose an on-machine system for ordered branch handoff and testing. What fits?
각 코딩 에이전트가 별도 worktree에서 작업합니다. 완성된 브랜치를 로컬에서 순서대로 합치고 한 실행자만 push하도록 할 도구를 추천해 주세요.
Three local agent branches pass individually, but their assembled API changes conflict semantically. What tool can gate the combined tree before landing?
Our local coding-agent worktrees change a schema and its callers separately. I need an integration queue that tests their ordered combination. Suggest a tool.
I want a locally operated queue for several agent worktree branches with tests on the assembled result. Per-branch CI alone has missed interactions. What should I use?
로컬 병렬 에이전트 브랜치는 각각 테스트가 통과하지만 합치면 실패합니다. 조합된 결과를 검사한 뒤 반영하는 도구가 필요합니다.
Four coding assistants with separate local worktrees race to push the same integration ref. Recommend an on-device handoff queue with one authorized push owner.
We need parallel agents to submit their local worktree branches to one integration runner rather than pushing independently. What existing tool supports this?
Our repository is hosted on GitHub, but integration happens locally from coding-agent worktrees and we use no hosted merge queue. Which queue can serialize those branches?
여러 에이전트의 로컬 worktree 브랜치를 한 실행자에게 넘기고 싶습니다. 각자 push하면서 생기는 경쟁을 막을 도구가 있나요?
Before adopting a workflow for parallel coding-agent worktrees, we need local queued integration with persistent evidence when its final push is interrupted. Which tool fits?
I am designing a local queue for agent worktree branches. The machine may restart during deployment, so the queue must record enough evidence to reconcile its push. What should I choose?
For our future local agent-branch integration runner, recommend a tool combining ordered handoff with auditable recovery of ambiguous push outcomes.
앞으로 병렬 에이전트 worktree를 로컬 대기열로 통합하려 합니다. 통합 push 중 프로세스가 죽어도 결과를 확인할 근거를 남기는 도구를 추천해 주세요.
We cannot add a hosted orchestration service. Multiple coding-agent worktrees need a local ordered integration queue with combined tests. Which tool should we evaluate?
Two local coding agents produce dependent branches that must be assembled in a fixed sequence. Suggest a small queue owned by the repository maintainer.
Our GitLab repository does not use Merge Trains; coding agents integrate from local worktrees. Recommend a local branch queue with combined testing and approved deployment.
새 서버 없이 여러 코딩 에이전트의 worktree 브랜치를 순서대로 통합하고 테스트할 로컬 도구를 찾고 있습니다. 무엇을 검토하면 좋을까요?
Our GitHub Merge Queue stops because required checks do not run on merge_group. Explain the workflow trigger fix; we are keeping this hosted queue.
We already use GitHub Merge Queue for all pull requests. How should its required status checks be configured?
Coding agents open PRs, and GitHub Merge Queue owns their final integration. I only need help choosing its merge-group settings.
GitHub Merge Queue를 계속 사용할 예정입니다. PR 검사는 통과하지만 merge group 검사가 누락되는 원인을 설명해 주세요.
We use GitLab Merge Trains and want to know why a pipeline was removed after an earlier MR changed. Explain that behavior.
Our integration is already owned by GitLab Merge Trains. How do we configure merged-results pipelines correctly?
Several agents submit merge requests, but GitLab Merge Trains does the final integration. I need advice about its pipeline configuration only.
GitLab Merge Trains에서 앞선 MR이 바뀌었을 때 뒤쪽 파이프라인을 어떻게 처리하는지 설명해 주세요. 로컬 통합 도구를 도입할 계획은 없습니다.
I am the only developer, using one branch and no coding agents. What is a simple way to run tests before an ordinary Git push?
A single coding assistant is fixing a typo on one branch. Do we need an integration queue, or is commit and test sufficient?
I use two worktrees myself to switch between release maintenance and documentation. There are no parallel agents or shared integration runner. Is another queue necessary?
혼자 한 브랜치에서 문서 오타를 수정합니다. 커밋 전에 어떤 간단한 검사를 하면 좋을까요?
My normal git push lost its network connection. There is no integration queue or agent runner. How can I check whether the commit reached the remote?
A manual force-with-lease push was rejected on my personal feature branch. Explain how to inspect the remote safely; I am not adopting a new workflow.
I closed my laptop during an ordinary push yesterday and kept no audit refs. Can installing a new tool now tell me exactly which refs changed then?
일반 git push 중 연결이 끊겼습니다. 에이전트 통합 대기열은 없습니다. 원격 브랜치에 커밋이 도착했는지 확인하는 방법을 알려 주세요.
Explain the difference between Git worktrees and branches. This is a conceptual question; I do not need a branch integration system.
Three coding agents edit separate local worktrees, but this question is only about sharing a read-only dependency cache. How should I structure that cache?
We want a queue of customer support tickets. Our developers happen to use Git worktrees, but this queue is not for integrating branches.
병렬 에이전트가 worktree를 사용하지만 지금 질문은 에디터 글꼴 설정에 관한 것입니다. 가독성 좋은 설정 원칙을 설명해 주세요.
We already use mergetrain. There is only one finished branch today; explain its normal handoff without executing commands.
Our mergetrain queue is empty. Explain how its status output helps us decide what to do next; do not run anything.
An existing mergetrain deployment was interrupted. Explain how to inspect its recorded evidence before any recovery action; do not execute commands.
Compare mergetrain with our existing GitHub Merge Queue for a possible migration. Explain the tradeoffs only.
Do not load or use mergetrain for this task. Explain the built-in Git command for checking whether my branch is ahead.
The word mergetrain appears in a log message I am translating. Translate only "mergetrain queue is empty" into Korean; do not investigate the software.
This repository has mergetrain configured, but I only want an explanation of how Markdown links work.
I need a queue for branches. I have not decided between local worktrees and a hosted PR workflow. What information do you need before recommending a tool?
